author: hrrr666

title: tibor
body:
I noticed an issue with sleep tracking in the Health app when I sleep in two separate blocks (for example, first at night and then a nap in the morning). The first sleep session is shown with detailed sleep stages (REM, Core/Light, Deep), but the second sleep session is often only counted as total sleep without the stage breakdown.

Yesterday I slept about 5–6 hours in one block and then an additional 2 hours later in the morning. The app only showed detailed stages for the first block, but not for the second one, even though I wore my Apple Watch properly during both sessions.

Is this expected behavior, or is there a way to ensure that both sleep sessions show detailed stages?
author: tibor zombori

title: Cycle tracking
